title: Briakos corpus archaeology via lineara.xyz annotation-layer document identities

annotation_source.thesis_provenance: Briakos Appendix A reports annotations.js downloaded 2026-03-01 in the same Phase 1 acquisition as the inscription file.

bridge_rule.duplicate_annotation_names: record and fail identity uniqueness promotion; do not silently deduplicate for a positive claim

predeclared_outputs: annotation file exact byte count and full computed SHA256
annotation top-level item count and unique identity count
intersection count with admitted inscription effective keys

decision_rule.EXACT_IDENTITY_SCOPE_CANDIDATE: Annotation bytes match Briakos size/hash prefix, annotation IDs are collision-free, intersection count is 419, and complete published site fingerprint matches.
decision_rule.IDENTITY_LAYER_RELATED_BUT_NOT_SCOPE: Source identity checks pass and overlap is nonzero, but 419/site fingerprint fails.
decision_rule.SOURCE_IDENTITY_BLOCKED: Annotation bytes or SHA prefix do not match the source described by Briakos.
